info.title: Stacks Blockchain API
info.description:
Welcome to the API reference overview for the [Stacks Blockchain API](https://docs.hiro.so/stacks-blockchain-api).

      [Download Postman collection](https://hirosystems.github.io/stacks-blockchain-api/collection.json)

get.description: Retrieves the running status of the Stacks Blockchain API, including the server version and current chain tip information.

server_version.description: the server version that is currently running

block_height.description: the current block height

block_hash.description: the current block hash

microblock_hash.description: the current microblock hash

microblock_sequence.description: the current microblock sequence number

burn_block_height.description: the current burn chain block height

get.description: Retrieves all recently mined transactions

parameters.name: unanchored
parameters.description: Include data from unanchored (i.e. unconfirmed) microblocks

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Option to sort results by block height, timestamp, or fee

parameters.name: from_address
parameters.description: Option to filter results by sender address

parameters.name: to_address
parameters.description: Option to filter results by recipient address

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Filter by transactions after this timestamp (unix timestamp in seconds)

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Filter by transactions before this timestamp (unix timestamp in seconds)

parameters.name: contract_id
parameters.description: Option to filter results by contract ID

parameters.name: function_name
parameters.description: Filter by contract call transactions involving this function name

parameters.name: nonce
parameters.description: Filter by transactions with this nonce

nonce.description: Used for ordering the transactions originating from and paying from an account. The nonce ensures that a transaction is processed at most once. The nonce counts the number of times an account's owner(s) have authorized a transaction. The first transaction from an account will have a nonce value equal to 0, the second will have a nonce value equal to 1, and so on.

fee_rate.description: Transaction fee as Integer string (64-bit unsigned integer).

sponsored.description: Denotes whether the originating account is the same as the paying account

anchor_mode.description: `on_chain_only`: the transaction MUST be included in an anchored block, `off_chain_only`: the transaction MUST be included in a microblock, `any`: the leader can choose where to include the transaction.

block_hash.description: Hash of the blocked this transactions was associated with

block_height.description: Height of the block this transactions was associated with

block_time.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) indicating when this block was mined.

block_time_iso.description: An ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) indicating when this block was mined.

burn_block_time.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) indicating when this block was mined.

burn_block_height.description: Height of the anchor burn block.

burn_block_time_iso.description: An ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) timestamp indicating when this block was mined.

parent_burn_block_time.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) indicating when this parent block was mined

parent_burn_block_time_iso.description: An ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) timestamp indicating when this parent block was mined.

canonical.description: Set to `true` if block corresponds to the canonical chain tip

tx_index.description: Index of the transaction, indicating the order. Starts at `0` and increases with each transaction

tx_result.description: Result of the transaction. For contract calls, this will show the value returned by the call. For other transaction types, this will return a boolean indicating the success of the transaction.

hex.description: Hex string representing the value fo the transaction result

repr.description: Readable string of the transaction result

is_unanchored.description: True if the transaction is included in a microblock that has not been confirmed by an anchor block.

microblock_hash.description: The microblock hash that this transaction was streamed in. If the transaction was batched in an anchor block (not included within a microblock) then this value will be an empty string.

microblock_sequence.description: The microblock sequence number that this transaction was streamed in. If the transaction was batched in an anchor block (not included within a microblock) then this value will be 2147483647 (0x7fffffff, the max int32 value), this value preserves logical transaction ordering on (block_height, microblock_sequence, tx_index).

microblock_canonical.description: Set to `true` if microblock is anchored in the canonical chain tip, `false` if the transaction was orphaned in a micro-fork.

anyOf.description: Clarity VM error produced by this transaction

tenure_consensus_hash.description: Consensus hash of this tenure. Corresponds to the sortition in which the miner of this block was chosen.

prev_tenure_consensus_hash.description: Consensus hash of the previous tenure. Corresponds to the sortition of the previous winning block-commit.

burn_view_consensus_hash.description: Current consensus hash on the underlying burnchain. Corresponds to the last-seen sortition.

previous_tenure_blocks.description: The number of blocks produced in the previous tenure.

cause.description: Cause of change in mining tenure. Depending on cause, tenure can be ended or extended.

pubkey_hash.description: (Hex string) The ECDSA public key hash of the current tenure.

get.description:
Queries for transactions counts, age (by block height), fees (simple average), and size.
        All results broken down by transaction type and percentiles (p25, p50, p75, p95).

200.description: GET request that returns stats on mempool transactions

schema.title: MempoolTransactionStatsResponse
schema.description: GET request that returns stats on mempool transactions

tx_type_counts.description: Number of tranasction in the mempool, broken down by transaction type.

tx_simple_fee_averages.description: The simple mean (average) transaction fee, broken down by transaction type. Note that this does not factor in actual execution costs. The average fee is not a reliable metric for calculating a fee for a new transaction.

tx_ages.description: The average time (in blocks) that transactions have lived in the mempool. The start block height is simply the current chain-tip of when the attached Stacks node receives the transaction. This timing can be different across Stacks nodes / API instances due to propagation timing differences in the p2p network.

tx_byte_sizes.description: The average byte size of transactions in the mempool, broken down by transaction type.

get.description:
Retrieves the list of events filtered by principal (STX address or Smart Contract ID), transaction id or event types.
        The list of event types is ('smart_contract_log', 'stx_lock', 'stx_asset', 'fungible_token_asset', 'non_fungible_token_asset').

parameters.name: unanchored
parameters.description: Include data from unanchored (i.e. unconfirmed) microblocks

nonce.description: Used for ordering the transactions originating from and paying from an account. The nonce ensures that a transaction is processed at most once. The nonce counts the number of times an account's owner(s) have authorized a transaction. The first transaction from an account will have a nonce value equal to 0, the second will have a nonce value equal to 1, and so on.

fee_rate.description: Transaction fee as Integer string (64-bit unsigned integer).

sponsored.description: Denotes whether the originating account is the same as the paying account

anchor_mode.description: `on_chain_only`: the transaction MUST be included in an anchored block, `off_chain_only`: the transaction MUST be included in a microblock, `any`: the leader can choose where to include the transaction.

block_hash.description: Hash of the blocked this transactions was associated with

block_height.description: Height of the block this transactions was associated with

block_time.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) indicating when this block was mined.

block_time_iso.description: An ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) indicating when this block was mined.

burn_block_time.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) indicating when this block was mined.

burn_block_height.description: Height of the anchor burn block.

burn_block_time_iso.description: An ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) timestamp indicating when this block was mined.

parent_burn_block_time.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) indicating when this parent block was mined

parent_burn_block_time_iso.description: An ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) timestamp indicating when this parent block was mined.

canonical.description: Set to `true` if block corresponds to the canonical chain tip

tx_index.description: Index of the transaction, indicating the order. Starts at `0` and increases with each transaction

tx_result.description: Result of the transaction. For contract calls, this will show the value returned by the call. For other transaction types, this will return a boolean indicating the success of the transaction.

hex.description: Hex string representing the value fo the transaction result

repr.description: Readable string of the transaction result

is_unanchored.description: True if the transaction is included in a microblock that has not been confirmed by an anchor block.

microblock_hash.description: The microblock hash that this transaction was streamed in. If the transaction was batched in an anchor block (not included within a microblock) then this value will be an empty string.

microblock_sequence.description: The microblock sequence number that this transaction was streamed in. If the transaction was batched in an anchor block (not included within a microblock) then this value will be 2147483647 (0x7fffffff, the max int32 value), this value preserves logical transaction ordering on (block_height, microblock_sequence, tx_index).

microblock_canonical.description: Set to `true` if microblock is anchored in the canonical chain tip, `false` if the transaction was orphaned in a micro-fork.

get.summary: Get total and unlocked STX supply
get.description: Retrieves the total and unlocked STX supply. More information on Stacking can be found [here] (https://docs.stacks.co/understand-stacks/stacking).

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Supply details are queried from specified block height. If the block height is not specified, the latest block height is taken as default value. Note that the `block height` is referred to the stacks blockchain.

unlocked_stx.description: String quoted decimal number of the STX that have been mined or unlocked

block_height.description: The block height at which this information was queried

post.description:
Add 0.01 BTC token to the specified regtest BTC address.

        The endpoint returns the transaction ID, which you can use to view the transaction in a regtest Bitcoin block
        explorer. The tokens are delivered once the transaction has been included in a block.

        **Note:** This is a Bitcoin regtest-only endpoint. This endpoint will not work on the Bitcoin mainnet.

post.description:
Add 500 STX tokens to the specified testnet address. Testnet STX addresses begin with `ST`. If the `stacking`
        parameter is set to `true`, the faucet will add the required number of tokens for individual stacking to the
        specified testnet address.

        The endpoint returns the transaction ID, which you can use to view the transaction in the
        [Stacks Explorer](https://explorer.hiro.so/?chain=testnet). The tokens are delivered once the transaction has
        been included in an anchor block.

        A common reason for failed faucet transactions is that the faucet has run out of tokens. If you are experiencing
        failed faucet transactions to a testnet address, you can get help in [Discord](https://stacks.chat).

        **Note:** This is a testnet only endpoint. This endpoint will not work on the mainnet.
